title: Measuring and Mitigating Toxicity in Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Replication Study
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks toxicity in LLMs using datasets such as ToxiGen, which specifically include religious demographic groups (Jewish and Muslim people) as targets of implicit hate speech. By measuring how LLMs respond to and generate content about these religious groups, the study contains a component of benchmarking religious representation and bias.
